login.title: Sign in to Continente
login.description:
1. Open **[this Continente login link]({url})** and choose **Iniciar sessão** (not guest).
2. At the end the browser goes to `http://localhost/continente-ha?code=…` and shows an error — **that is expected**.
3. Copy that page's full address from the address bar and paste it here.

The link only works for this login; if you close this dialog, start again.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Continente to start the login. Try again later.

error.no_code: That address has no login code. Copy the full address, starting with http://localhost/continente-ha?code=…
error.wrong_state: That address belongs to another login. Use the link on this page.
error.login_refused: The login was cancelled or refused at Continente.
error.token_failed: Continente did not accept the code (it may have expired). Open the link again and paste the new address.

data_description.todo_entity: The list whose items get Continente prices.

price_list.name: Price shopping list
price_list.description: Matches every open item on the shopping list to a Continente product and returns prices.

choose_product.name: Choose product
choose_product.description: Remembers which Continente product to use for a shopping list item. Without a SKU, forgets the choice.

item.name: Item
item.description: Item name as it appears on the list.

send_to_basket.name: Send to basket
send_to_basket.description: Adds the matched products to the Continente basket (the same one as the app). Never places an order.

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: Return what would be added without touching the basket.

items.name: Products
items.description: Optional list of {sku, quantity}; by default, the whole shopping list.

get_product.name: Product details
get_product.description: Returns everything Continente knows about a product.

update_prices.name: Update purchase prices
update_prices.description: Reads today's price of the recently bought products now (normally at 9:00 and 18:00).

list_most_bought.name: Most bought
list_most_bought.description: Returns the Continente card "most bought" products as Continente sends them.
